findings.title: CVE-2099-1001: Mock Ubuntu kernel vulnerability candidate
findings.evidence: Offline mock DB matched OS fingerprint on 192.168.56.21: name=Ubuntu, version=22.04, kernel=5.15.0, build=unknown using exact match. Enumerated OS CPE: cpe:/o:canonical:ubuntu_linux:22.04.
findings.remediation: Review Ubuntu security notices and apply the approved kernel update.

findings.title: CVE-2021-41773: Apache HTTP Server path traversal
findings.evidence: Offline mock DB matched Apache httpd 2.4.49 on 192.168.56.21:8080/tcp using exact match. Enumerated CPE: cpe:/a:apache:http_server:2.4.49.
findings.remediation: Upgrade Apache HTTP Server to a supported patched release.
